pricing.caseOffer: We are a new studio and we need examples of our work. So we do our first five projects at the “case-study price” (a case study is an example of our work): development is 30% off. The discount is taken from the regular development price. Options, MAX and support are at the regular price. We give the discount right away: the contract states the discounted price, and all three payments are calculated from it. We will tell you how many spots are left when we reply to your request. In return we ask for two things. First, you let us show your site or app as an example of our work, without your customers' data. Second, you write a review of how the work went, any review, including a critical one. We publish critical reviews the same way as positive ones.

basics.revisions: Three rounds of revisions included. A round is all your comments in one list, and we make all of it. Revisions are texts, photos, the color of individual blocks and buttons, the order of blocks; new pages, features and a whole new style are separate work
basics.warranty: A one-year warranty from the day you accepted the work and signed the acceptance certificate. We start fixing it within 2 hours; at night, on a weekend or a public holiday, within the first 2 hours of the next working day. Urgent issues come before all other work. Other bugs we start fixing within a working day and fix within 5 working days. If it is unclear whose fault a breakdown is, we first look for the cause for free and show it to you. The warranty does not cover outages at the hosting provider, the company whose server the site runs on, failures of third-party services such as Telegram or a booking service, or breakdowns after you or other people changed the site's code. Such repairs cost $90 an hour. Texts and photos you change through the admin panel do not void the warranty.

process.heading: How we build a one-page site in 4 days
process.contractNote: We fix all four in the contract

brief.title: Choosing a style and the top of the home page
brief.text: Before the start we show the top of the home page, the part people see first, in three styles. You pick one, and from that day the deadline runs: that is day 1. On the same day we turn that top part into a real page you can open on your phone. You send your comments on it in one list: that is the first of three rounds of revisions. Comments on the rest of the page come in the second and third rounds.

concept.title: The whole site on a temporary link
concept.text: We make your first-round revisions and build the whole site: every section, the form where customers leave requests, and visitor analytics. For now the site opens on a temporary link, so you can review it before launch. You send the second list of comments.

staging.title: Revisions and the speed test
staging.text: We make your second-round revisions. We check how fast the site opens on a phone: Google's speed test gives a page a score from 0 to 100. Every page listed in the contract needs 90 or more in each of three runs in a row; otherwise we keep working at our own expense. We show you the result, you make the second payment of 40% and send the third and final list of comments.

launch.title: Launch and a one-year warranty
launch.text: We make your third-round revisions and move the site to your web address (domain): now everyone can see it. We test the speed again, this time there. We hand over the passwords and all the code: you can change the site or pass it to another developer without us. You sign the acceptance certificate, the document that confirms the work is accepted, and pay the final 30%. Then comes a one-year warranty.

materials.title: Materials
materials.text: Before the contract we send a list of what the site needs: texts, photos, a logo. No texts of your own? We write them: we send a questionnaire about your business, talk with you and write the texts from your answers. That is included in the price, but the site will be ready 2 days later. This does not delay the styles, the options for how the site looks: we show them 2 working days after the prepayment and your answers to the questionnaire. No photos of your own? We put in temporary ones from photo banks, sites where businesses buy photos. Texts we write, you see every time we show you the site: check the prices, addresses and services in them, only you know those.

prepayment.title: Prepayment and start date
prepayment.text: The contract sets a start date: the day we have time free for your site. By that date we need two things: the prepayment (30% of the price of the site) and the materials from our list. Missed that date? As soon as the prepayment and materials arrive, within a working day we name a new date: the nearest one when we have time. The prepayment is not lost: it counts toward the payment. The new date does not suit you? Until you pick a style, you can cancel and we refund the whole prepayment.

style.title: Choosing a style
style.text: A style is how the site looks: colors, fonts, the shape of buttons and blocks. 2 working days after the prepayment and the materials we show the top of your home page in three different styles. None of them fit? 2 working days after your reply we show three more. None of those fit either? We refund the whole prepayment within 10 working days and close the contract. You can also take a ready-made style right away: one of the five styles of this site (the “Style” button switches them) or the style of our demo, a ready example site we made to show what we do. Another client may pick a ready-made style too, but a style you pick from the ones drawn for you is yours alone.

refusal.title: If you change your mind
refusal.text: Changed your mind before picking a style? Email us, and within 10 working days we refund the whole prepayment. Changed your mind later? You pay only for the work done, at $90 for each hour of our work. We send a report: what was done and how many hours it took. Hours spent on the styles we drew before you picked one are not in the report. Until we have made your second list of changes, the amount is no more than 70% of the price. Payments you have made count: paid more than the work done costs? We return the extra within 10 working days. Paid less? You pay the rest.

deadlines.title: Deadlines in the contract
deadlines.text: The contract sets the deadline for the site and the days when we show the styles. The deadline runs from the day you pick a style: the days for showing the styles do not count toward it. If we are late through our fault, the price goes down. Late showing the styles: 2% for each working day. Late handing over the site: 2% for each day, weekends and public holidays included. We count the percentage from the whole contract price including options, paid extras such as online payment. All delays together take off no more than 20%. We take this amount off the final payment: you simply pay less. For example, with a price of $2,000, being 2 working days late with the styles means $80 off.

pauses.title: When the clock stops
pauses.text: We pause the clock while we wait for your reply, materials or payment: the delivery date moves by the same number of days, with no penalties for you. Asked for something that is not in the contract, such as a new page? First we name the price and the new deadline; neither changes without your consent. If a round of edits needs more than 8 hours of work, we tell you before we start how many days the deadline moves: those days are not a delay. Any other delay is our fault, even if we are ill or busy with other orders: the price goes down for it, as in the “Deadlines in the contract” card. If the site is slow and we work on it to reach 90 points, those days count toward the deadline too: late because of that work? The price goes down too.

silence.title: If we hear nothing for a long time
silence.text: If you do not reply or do not pay for 30 days in a row, we may close the contract by sending you an email. Closed before you pick a style? We refund the whole prepayment. Closed later? We settle up as in the “If you change your mind” card: you pay for the work done by the hour. For six months after the email you can come back and continue the same project at the same price.

speed.title: Speed
speed.text: On launch day we test the speed again with Google's test, this time on your address: it needs 90 out of 100 or more in each of three runs in a row. We attach the result to the acceptance certificate, the document that confirms the work is accepted. Below 90 because of our code or our hosting setup? We fix it for free and do not hand over the work until it reaches 90. A third-party widget, a window from another service such as online booking or a map, slows pages down. If you asked for one, we tell you before the contract what score we promise with it; if you ask later, we tell you before we add it.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.text: We email you the acceptance certificate, a document saying the work is accepted. Within 10 working days, sign it or tell us what does not work the way the contract says. We fix that at no extra charge within 5 working days and send the certificate again; wishes that are not in the contract are not a reason not to sign. No reply within 10 working days? The work counts as accepted, as if you had signed: the warranty starts that day, and it is time to pay the final 30%.

warranty.title: A one-year warranty
warranty.text: For a year from the date of the certificate we fix for free anything that broke through our fault or does not work the way the contract says: for example, requests stop coming from the form because of a bug in our code, or the speed drops below 90 points because of our code. If it is unclear whose fault it is, we first look for the cause for free and show it to you with evidence that another developer can check if you like. Texts and photos you change in the admin panel, the section for your own edits, do not void the warranty.

repairs.title: How fast we fix things
repairs.text: Message us on Telegram or by email; the contacts are in the contract. Urgent means that through our fault the site does not open, requests do not arrive or payment fails. Wrote on a weekday from 10:00 to 19:00 Moscow time? We start fixing it within 2 hours. Wrote at night, on a weekend or a public holiday? Within the first 2 hours of the next working day. Urgent issues come before all other work. Other bugs we start fixing within one working day of your message. We fully fix any bug within 5 working days at most.

notOurFault.title: If it is not our fault
notOurFault.text: Not our fault means, for example, that another developer changed the site's code, a third-party service (Telegram, an online booking service, a payment service) broke or changed its rules, or the hosting provider, the company the site's server is rented from, had an outage. We fix such things for a separate fee: $90 an hour. We first name the total, never charge more than that, and start the repair only if you agree.

upkeep.title: Updates and backups
upkeep.text: Updates to the software the site runs on and backups, snapshots of the site with all its data, are part of support: a separate monthly fee, optional. The warranty does not depend on support: we fix bugs in our code for free all year without it. But without support we do not make backups. After a failure we rebuild the site from the code: free if the failure is our fault, $90 an hour if it is the hosting's. Whatever appeared after launch, requests and bookings in the admin panel, texts and photos you changed, may be lost. Requests that already reached you by email stay there. With support we restore the site from a backup, and that is part of the monthly fee.

faq.question: How is a site for your industry different from “Start”?
faq.answer: “Start” is a one-page site. The site for your industry has several pages with sections and features for your industry. For each industry on the list we have a demo, an example of a finished site. We take its structure: the sections and features your industry needs, such as a menu with filters for a cafe or doctors with prices for a clinic. The design is drawn for you: three styles to choose from, as in “Start”. If you like the style of the demo itself, you can take it. Either way the site is yours: with your texts, your photos and on your address. The site for your industry costs more than “Start” and takes longer: it has several pages and features for your industry, while “Start” is one page. It has as many pages as the demo for your industry; a new page is separate work. For a clinic we add a notice about contraindications and the license details, and you are responsible for the medical texts. The deadline is {term}.

faq.answer: In {term}. We count calendar days, weekends included. The deadline starts the day you pick the style of the site, and it is set in the contract. We show three styles 2 working days after the prepayment and the materials. If we write the texts, the deadline is 2 days longer. Days we spend waiting for your comments don't count: the delivery date moves by the same number of days. There is no need to rush your reply. If a pause drags on for a long time, the contract says what happens next. If we are late through our own fault, we cut the price by 2% for each day of delay, 20% at most. That amount comes off the final payment.

faq.question: Can I add features later?

We settle up as in the “If you change your mind” card: you pay for the work done by the hour. For six months after the email you can come back and continue the same project at the same price.

speed.title: Speed
speed.text: Before handover we check how fast the service opens on a phone with Google's test on the pages listed in the contract: it needs 90 out of 100 or more in each of three runs in a row. We fix it for free and do not hand over the work until it reaches 90. A third-party widget, a window from another service such as a chat or a map, slows pages down. If you asked for one, we tell you before the contract what score we promise with it; if you ask later, we tell you before we add it. We test the pages that open without signing in: the home page, sign-in and sign-up. Google's test cannot open accounts behind a password.

acceptance.text: We email you the acceptance certificate, a document saying the work is accepted. Within 10 working days, sign it or tell us what does not work the way the contract says. warranty.text: For a year from the date of the certificate we fix for free anything that broke through our fault or does not work the way the contract says: for example, payments fail because of a bug in our code, or the speed drops below 90 points because of our code. repairs.text: Message us on Telegram or by email; the contacts are in the contract. Urgent means that through our fault the service does not open, or sign-in or payment fails. Urgent issues come before all other work. Other bugs we start fixing within one working day of your message. We fully fix any bug within 5 working days at most.

notOurFault.title: If it is not our fault

upkeep.text: Updates to the software the service runs on and backups, snapshots of the service with all its data, are part of support: a separate monthly fee, optional. The warranty does not depend on support: we fix bugs in our code for free all year without it. But without support we do not make backups. After a failure we rebuild the service from the code: free if the failure is our fault, $90 an hour if it is the hosting's. Whatever appeared after launch, user accounts, their data and the payment records in the service, may be lost. With support we restore the service from a backup, and that is part of the monthly fee.

We return the extra within 10 working days. Paid less? You pay the rest.

Within 1 working day we tell you exactly what. We count the percentage from the whole contract price including options, paid extras in the contract, but not work you asked for on top of it. All delays together take off no more than 20%. We take this amount off the final payment: you simply pay less.

faq.answer: We build one from scratch using photos and drawings. It is a separate line in both the estimate and the schedule, priced before any prepayment so the cost does not change mid-project.

faq.question: How does 3D work on older phones?
faq.answer: First the visitor sees a regular image of the model, and the 3D loads after it. If a phone cannot show 3D (it lacks the WebGL 2.0 technology), it shows an image and a video instead, and the inquiry form works either way. On a weak phone the model may rotate more slowly, but the image, the labels and the inquiry form are there right away.

faq.question: How much do revisions cost after three lists of comments?
faq.answer: Three rounds of revisions are included: texts, colors and highlights. After that each change is paid by the hour: we name the amount first, and you never pay more than that. We charge $90 an hour. Once you approve the shape of the model itself, we do not change it as part of revisions. If you need to show a new part or a new viewing angle, we name the price first and then do it.

faq.question: Can you put 3D on Tilda, WordPress or 1C-Bitrix?

We embed a 3D block into such a site: yours, if developers wrote it without a website builder, or one we built. If your site is on a website builder, we can make a 3D landing page, a separate page with its own address, such as 3d.yoursite.com, and link to it from your site.

faq.question: What is the difference between a 3D block and a 3D landing page?
faq.answer: A 3D block is one 3D model that we embed into a site written in code: yours or one we built. A 3D landing page is a separate one-page site with the model at its center. We write the texts for it from your answers to our questions. The page has an inquiry form and everything from the “Included in the price of every site” list, site visit statistics included.

More complex means a whole production line or a building, a model from a 3D scanner, or a file with broken surfaces that have to be fixed by hand. Send us the file: we will look at it for free and tell you before the prepayment whether simplifying it is included in the price.
